{%- extends "!layout.html" %} {#- Top-left logo links to docs.tenstorrent.com; the project title links to this site's own home (its index), so each component site stays coherent. #} {%- block sidebartitle %} {%- set _logo_url = logo_url|default(pathto('_static/' + (logo or ""), 1)) %} {%- set _root_doc = root_doc|default(master_doc) %} {%- if logo or logo_url %} {%- endif %} {{ project }} {%- include "searchbox.html" %} {%- endblock %} {#- Shared Cloud-Native Support sidebar. The component list is the single shared manifest, owned by tenstorrent.github.io and vendored with this theme. It renders only when a site opts in via html_context["cns_component"], so the docs.tenstorrent.com umbrella and unrelated projects using this theme are unaffected. Some entries are pages that physically live inside another component's repo (Node Feature Discovery and Multi-Node Scheduling live in tt-operator; Firmware lives in tt-k8s-driver-manager). Each such entry carries a "page" docname. The switcher is page-aware: when the current page is one of those sub-pages, that entry is highlighted and its host component collapses to a plain link, so a sub-page reads as its own component rather than opening the host's full navigation. Otherwise the host (primary) entry is active and its own page navigation (with its section captions) nests beneath it. #} {%- block menu %} {%- if cns_component is defined and cns_component %} {%- set cns_items = [ {"label": "TT-Operator", "code": "tt-operator", "primary": true, "page": "index", "url": "https://docs.tenstorrent.com/tt-operator/"}, {"label": "Node Feature Discovery", "code": "tt-operator", "primary": false, "page": "components/node-feature-discovery", "url": "https://docs.tenstorrent.com/tt-operator/components/node-feature-discovery.html"}, {"label": "Driver Manager", "code": "tt-k8s-driver-manager", "primary": true, "page": "index", "url": "https://docs.tenstorrent.com/tt-k8s-driver-manager/"}, {"label": "Firmware", "code": "tt-k8s-driver-manager", "primary": false, "page": "firmware", "url": "https://docs.tenstorrent.com/tt-k8s-driver-manager/firmware.html"}, {"label": "Telemetry", "code": "tt-telemetry", "primary": true, "page": "index", "url": "https://docs.tenstorrent.com/tt-telemetry/"}, {"label": "Fabric Manager (beta)", "code": "tt-fabric-manager", "primary": true, "page": "index", "url": "https://docs.tenstorrent.com/tt-fabric-manager/"}, {"label": "Device Allocation (beta)", "code": "tt-dra-driver", "primary": true, "page": "index", "url": "https://docs.tenstorrent.com/tt-dra-driver/"}, {"label": "Multi-Node Scheduling (beta)", "code": "tt-operator", "primary": false, "page": "components/multi-node", "url": "https://docs.tenstorrent.com/tt-operator/components/multi-node.html"}, ] %} {#- Is the current page one of this site's promoted sub-pages? #} {%- set ns = namespace(subpage_active=false) %} {%- for c in cns_items %} {%- if c.code == cns_component and not c.primary and c.page == pagename %}{% set ns.subpage_active = true %}{% endif %} {%- endfor %} {%- set component_nav = toctree(maxdepth=4, collapse=True, includehidden=True, titles_only=True) | replace('toctree-l4', 'toctree-l5') | replace('toctree-l3', 'toctree-l4') | replace('toctree-l2', 'toctree-l3') | replace('toctree-l1', 'toctree-l2') %}
